join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply add a1 what
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply add a2 what
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply add a3 what
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply add a4 what
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply add a5 what
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=subscriber :!autoreply compact 1
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply compact 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Compacted autoreplies 1 and above (0 affected).


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply remove 2
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply remove 4
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply list
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Autoreplies: 1: ^a1$ -> what ; 3: ^a3$ -> what ; 5: ^a5$ -> what


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply compact 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Compacted autoreplies 1 and above (2 affected).

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply list
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Autoreplies: 1: ^a1$ -> what ; 2: ^a3$ -> what ; 3: ^a5$ -> what


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply compact
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !autoreply compact <num>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply compact 0
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !autoreply compact <num>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply compact -1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !autoreply compact <num>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply compact what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !autoreply compact <num>
